name: Balnir Farmstead
summary: In eastern Tirisfal, Balnir Farmstead lies ruined beyond the Bulwark. Once worked by the Balnir family, the estate now draws Scourge that slip past the defenses.

sections.title: A Farm Before the Plague
sections.body: Snapdragons still bloom in the garden where the Balnir family worked their homestead for generations. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War, the farm was overrun and its people were lost. The buildings now rot among the hills of eastern Tirisfal.

sections.title: Desolation and Scourge Infiltration
sections.body: Mindless Scourge slip past the Bulwark and gather among the farmstead's ruins. Forsaken deathguards watch the farm warily, while Undercity magi gather surviving snapdragons from its garden. They study the flowers to learn how deeply plague corruption has reached into the soil.

faq.q: Why is the Balnir Farmstead important?
faq.answer: Balnir Farmstead lies just behind the Bulwark on Tirisfal's eastern approaches. Scourge that slip past the defenders gather there, and Forsaken mages study the garden's snapdragons to measure how far the plague has spread into Tirisfal.

faq.q: Who lived at the farmstead before the plague?
faq.answer: The Balnir family lived and worked at the farm, which bears their name. They were lost when the Scourge swept through Tirisfal during the Third War, and only the undead walk its fields now.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken monitoring the farm now?
faq.answer: Mindless Scourge slip past the Bulwark from the Plaguelands and gather at the farmstead, threatening Tirisfal's eastern approaches. Undercity scholars also study the resilient snapdragons still growing in the gardens to measure how far plague contamination has spread.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, Balnir Farmstead recalls the Lordaeron they lost. Scourge from the Plaguelands still slip behind the Bulwark, leaving a breach in their defenses.
Forsaken magi gather surviving Balnir snapdragons from these blighted grounds and study them for the Scourge's lingering magical taint.
